newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Camelot /Teck make offer for Mt Edon.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Camelot /Teck make offer for Mt Edon.

text.p: Camelot Resources NL said on Wednesday it had made a joint bid with Canada's Teck Corp for Western Australian gold producer Mt Edon Gold Mines (AUstralia) Ltd at an offer price of A$2.15 per share.
Camelot said the offer would be made through a jointly owned special purpose company with Teck called Reachwest Pty Ltd.
"Reachwest purchased approximately 14.2 percent of the shares in Mt Edon during trading today and now holds approximately 14.5 percent of Mt Edon," the company said.
Earlier on Wednesday, a parcel of 6.55 million shares was crossed through Melbourne broker J.B. Were and Son at a price of A$2.10 per share.
Camelot said the offer was subject to a number of conditions including 90 percent acceptance and the spot gold price not falling below US$335.

"Camelot and Teck are confident that the offer will be well received by Mt Edon shareholders, particularly in light of the substantial premium of 48 percent to the last sale price of Mt Edon yesterday," Camelot said.
Camelot announced a strategic alliance with Teck in June last year. Under the alliance, Teck would eventually achieve ownership of a 19.99 percent shareholding in Camelot.
Mt Edon shares closed 64 cents higher at A$2.09 on turnover of 12.6 million shares, while Camelot stock was steady at 30 cents on turnover of 1.1 million shares.
